teaser: Six in the morning, and the line outside the polling station has not moved in ten minutes, though you are working out how long before the doors open and who should go first. You are a life path 1, an ISTJ, and what is particular to this crossing is how early the discipline starts: the drive to lead meets a mind built to check and recheck before trusting its own authority. Most people carrying a 1 chafe against rules until they can make their own. You make the rules first, then hold to them harder than anyone would ask of you.
excerpt: One evening you fix the neighbor's porch railing before they even notice it was loose.
